$comment: American Samoa has NO single minimum wage. Federal law itself sets 18 different industry rates there, all below $7.25, stepping up $0.40 every three years on September 30 until they converge on the generally applicable federal rate. Any lookup that answers '$7.25' for American Samoa is wrong in both directions -- too high for garment manufacturing, too low for finance and insurance.

scheduledChanges.change: +$0.40 per hour to every industry rate
scheduledChanges.note: Fair Minimum Wage Act of 2007 (P.L. 110-28) as amended by P.L. 114-61: $0.40 every three years on September 30 (2021, 2024, 2027, ...) until each rate reaches the federal minimum wage. The 2024-09-30 step is the one currently in effect; nothing changes on 2026-09-30.
